_about: The site's metrics, defined once. Each is numerator / denominator, written as columns joined by + or -, over the table it's defined on (fraud_totals unless a table says otherwise). assets/metrics.js computes them for the /live page; scripts/build_metrics.py turns them into data/pipeline/metrics.sql (a DuckDB macro per metric and the fraud_metrics view), which the SQL source editors and the nightly data run both load; the catalog lists them. claims tie a sentence of site copy to a metric, and the data run fails a check when the sentence and the number stop agreeing.

catch_rate.label: Catch rate
catch_rate.description: Share of fraudulent orders the rules flagged (sent to review or declined).

miss_rate.label: Fraud approved
miss_rate.description: Share of fraudulent orders the rules approved: the fraud that got through.

false_decline_rate.label: Good customers declined
false_decline_rate.description: Share of legitimate orders the rules declined outright.

legit_flag_rate.label: Good customers flagged
legit_flag_rate.description: Share of legitimate orders the rules sent to review or declined.

dollars_stopped_share.label: Fraud dollars stopped
dollars_stopped_share.description: Share of attempted fraud dollars on orders the rules flagged.

fraud_rate.label: Fraud rate
fraud_rate.description: Share of all checkouts that were fraudulent.

timeout_rate.label: Scoring timeouts
timeout_rate.description: Share of checkouts whose fraud score timed out and failed open (approved unscored).
